title: Menu overhaul: five-item public header, folded footer, role sections in the member rail

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-03: cull the menus, take marketing straight into joining, role functions in the left menu; picks 1A 2A 3A 4A 5A 6A. Strategy report: /mnt/project-files/menu-strategy-2026-11-03/REPORT.md

detail: Public header: Discover and For Spaces menus (the six operator doors live in For Spaces), then Business Spaces, Pricing and Help; one Get started button to /join; the Features mega menu is retired (FEATURES_MENU_ENABLED) and /features is linked from For Spaces. Footer: five quick links and a native More from Frequency fold holding every column (JSON-LD unchanged). Signed-in app: the website row is About, Pricing, Help Center and Guidelines (no sales links); Your Spaces, Create, Leadership and the Admin console are open role sections in the left rail; About, Pricing and Guidelines join the rail's quick links. Not in this row (follow-up PRs): merge /vision, /system, /networks, /calm-down-fast with 301s, and the /for door merges (13 to 9) once Search Console traffic is exported. Probe: node scripts/probes/menu-overhaul.mjs.
